name: messages
version5Does: Same: a rounded card per message with the time under it, markdown in the text, the user's cards set apart from the agent's. Better: a card also shows who the message is for when it is a reply.

name: marks
version5Does: Same: one muted line of about 28 pixels with the row's own title, no check mark. Better: the line's icon takes its tone from the mark's outcome, and a mark with detail opens in place.

name: docked
version5Does: Same: a bordered card with the row's icon, title, a line of its text, and open, dock and close buttons. Better: the card counts down its own leaving time and holds while the pointer is on it.

name: notices
version5Does: Same: a strip above the chat with a dot, the text, a button with the link and a close cross. Better: a notice belongs to the notices module, so a module without notices shows no strip.

name: composer
version5Does: Same: a tall rounded box, placeholder Message the agent, an attach button, Dump files, the running tool under the last message and a button to scroll to the top. Better: the box grows with its text.

name: dump-files
version5Does: Same: Dump files starts a dump from what the person pastes or drops, a part to a paragraph or file. Better: the form opens in place above the composer, and the dump is made through the dumps module's own command.

name: top-bars
version5Does: Same: an agent bar and an information bar, and window buttons that each carry their own icon before their label. Better: the bars are drawn by the shell from what the modules declare, so a new module's figure needs no shell change.

name: top-bars-1024
version5Does: Same: the bars fit at 1024 wide with nothing cut off. Better: the window buttons that do not fit fold into a More menu, so Presets and Full screen always stay on screen.

name: side-panels-left
version5Does: Same: a left sidebar listing the suite's pages and the environments with New environment. Better: the pages come from the suite's declaration, never from a list in the shell.

name: side-panels-right
version5Does: Same: an Activity panel on the right. Better: it is a window like any other, so it can also be split, moved or detached.
